    DigIntoScripture

    Bible places · archaeology · Scripture

    About DigIntoScripture

    DigIntoScripture maps the places of the Bible and what archaeology has found there. Tap a pin to see the dig, the finds, and the Scripture it connects to. Each pin shows how strong the evidence is (strong, mixed, or weak), and travel and visitor notes come with a reminder to check before you go.

    On first open, only Old Testament digs and New Testament digs are turned on. Use Layers (top right) to check off or start more layers. Search finds sites by modern and ancient names.

    Hints are on by default for new visitors. Uncheck to turn them off (you can turn them back on here anytime). Long-press Discover (or Tours) for the category Tours sheet — four story categories of guided walks.

    Quick start

    1. Era filter — narrows which pins show inside each layer by time period. A site stays visible when its listed eras overlap the eras you leave checked.
    2. Solid dig — A real excavation with finds that fit the Bible’s places or people — some are strong matches, others mainly set the scene; check Sources.
      Contested — The dig or claim was steered by a Bible idea, but later work disagreed, walked it back, or retracted it — read the popup before treating it as settled.
    3. Sources — tap any pin, then scroll the story panel for a Sources line (and related evidence). Empty fields stay hidden.

    Discover

    Guided tours by category · 5–12 stops · pan pin → panel → next · LSB refs on screen

    Mission Work

    Upcoming mission trips you can join, from each organization’s own trip page. Past trips hide automatically. Tap a trip for details and the official sign-up link. Always confirm dates and cost on the official page.
